components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button, used for 'Scan your crop'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #22C55E); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #060D09); padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Container for triage timeline, diagnosis results, and key actions.
components.html:
Action Plan: 0–2 Hours

Isolate affected plants immediately.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card, rgba(13, 28, 19, 0.75)); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.28)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; color: var(--color-foreground, #FFFFFF); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #A7F3D0); line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: AgriScan is built for growers outdoors in direct sunlight: one hand on the crop, one hand holding a mobile phone, stressed because their livelihood is at risk. It feels like an essential, calm, precision agricultural diagnostic instrument—trustworthy, rapid, uncluttered, and uncompromisingly legible.
keyCharacteristics: High text contrast for outdoor sunlight
Restrained physical materials (max one blur, no pulsing glow)
One clear promise on landing: Scan your crop

rules.name: The Single Canvas Rule
rules.body: Every view and surface renders atop bg-background. bg-slate-950 and arbitrary hex darks are strictly banned.

rules.name: The Token Fidelity Rule
rules.body: Never declare raw hex codes or Tailwind default color scales in component templates. Use semantic theme tokens.

rules.name: The Font Class Rule
rules.body: Typography uses font-sans and font-serif utility classes exclusively. Inline fontFamily and Georgia are prohibited.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Text color is always solid token foreground. Gradient text is forbidden.

dos: Do test every screen at 360px–375px mobile width
Do ensure all interactive controls have a minimum touch target of 48px height
Do verify changes by running npx tsc --noEmit
donts: Don't use bg-slate-950 or any slate color classes
Don't use raw hex codes in component classes or inline styles
Don't use inline fontFamily or mention Georgia directly
Don't use gradient text or pulsing glowing shadows
Don't display fake telemetry or unverifiable enterprise certifications
